title: Puffco Peak Smart Rig Replacement Atomizer
description:
The Peak atomizer is a thermal-banger style, designed for optimal heat performance. It’s made without the use of any coils, glues, plastics, or fibres, creating the purest consumption experience ever. It contains a ceramic bowl that provides the best possible flavour and heat profile.
Atomizer Features:

Designed for optimal heat performance
Made without the use of any coils, glues, plastics, or fibres
Ceramic bowl

What’s in the Box:

1x – Base
1x – Ceramic bowl
1x – Ring
